fields.rt-blog-html:
"Those who are going to have difficulties are those who do their job badly"
Christophe Juville - Founder and manager of the Spok franchise network.

If we tell you "urban lunchroom" (you'll quickly understand why 😉 which revolutionizes the lunch break with a very marked DNA, mixes the fundamentals of traditional catering with those of fast food, all sprinkled with playlists and in-house architecture... you think of what, or rather who?

4 letters that come straight from Marseille: SPOK.

We welcome Christophe Juville, Founder and Manager of the SPOK franchise network for our 13th episode of the podcast "Restaurateurs de demain".

A restaurant owner for whom "everything is going well": new projects, restaurant openings, a relationship all in ♥️ with his franchisees ... Christophe makes us smile with his enthusiasm and his positivity.

Find yourself a bench in the sun, a pair of headphones and let yourself go while listening to this new episode! 🌞🎙️

Guest of the week
